title: Senior Market Research Analyst
description:
About us:

At Toluna, we keep the world's biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we've been a leader in consumer insights, and today we're at the center of our industry's biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.

Brands come to us because we've solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we've been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.

Introduction:

We are looking for a senior market research analyst to join our amazing team in Brazil! You are the ideal candidate for this role if you have at least 4 years of market research experience, ideally on the supplier side. In this position, you will be responsible for leading the full project life cycle, from set-up through client presentations.

You'll work across multiple research methodologies within Product & Innovation (idea and concept testing, market exploration, and packaging testing) and Brand & Communication (advertising testing, media and campaign effectiveness, brand assessment) in a dynamic environment, where AI-powered solutions are already a reality.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and execution of research projects to meet complex needs with minimal support.
  • Independently manage medium-to-highly complex quantitative & qualitative studies across a variety of methodologies from survey design through final delivery to clients.
  • Develop compelling, story-led analyses and final reports with strategic, clear, and engaging client presentations.
  • Responsible for leading final client presentations, providing consistent, clear, and actionable recommendations.
  • Manage all client communications, providing clear and proactive communication regarding project progress.
  • Manage multiple projects at once in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work together with project managers and operations for deployment and execution while maintaining overall management of timelines.
  • Share your expertise with junior and mid-level research analysts, acting as a knowledge multiplier and recognized as a strong technical contributor within the team.

Your profile:

  • Bachelor's degree and at least 4 years of market research experience.
  • Experience in various research methodologies such as ad-hoc, ad concept testing, ad pre-testing, campaign evaluation, pack testing, brand tracking, shopper research, segmentation, U&A, iHUTs, etc.
  • Demonstrated success in questionnaire design, analysis, client presentation, and project management.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop effective working relationships with both internal partners and external clients.
  • Languages: English proficiency is mandatory; additional language skills are a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with an ability to multitask and effectively prioritize own workload.

**Please submit your CV in English

Our Values:

Acting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability

Bringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial

Collaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness

Discussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

Embracing empathy- Being egoless & caring

What we offer:

At Toluna, we're all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you're passionate about making an impact, we'd love to have you on board.

Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal voucher, transportation voucher, TotalPass and language class subsidy.

Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Analista de Operações Júnior (Chargeback e Intercâmbio)

Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

title: Consultor(a) Júnior de Soluções | Pré-Vendas Técnico
description:
Sobre a Sinergis

Somos uma consultoria especializada em ClickUp e outras ferramentas de produtividade, ajudando empresas a transformarem seus processos de trabalho. Trabalhamos com clientes de diversos segmentos, desde startups até grandes corporações, desenhando soluções sob medida que geram resultado real. Se você curte tecnologia, organização e quer crescer rápido em um ambiente que valoriza autonomia e aprendizado constante, essa vaga foi feita pra você.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) Júnior de Soluções para integrar nosso time Comercial, atuando na frente de pré-vendas técnico.

Você será o elo entre o time de vendas e a entrega técnica: vai acompanhar leads durante todo o funil comercial, participar de reuniões técnicas, montar demonstrações personalizadas e ajudar nossos clientes a enxergarem o valor real das soluções que oferecemos, principalmente no ClickUp.

Não precisa ser expert. Precisa ter curiosidade, vontade de aprender e facilidade pra se comunicar. A gente te desenvolve no resto.

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com leads junto ao time comercial, entendendo processos, dores e necessidades de cada potencial cliente.
  • Montar Provas de Conceito (PoC): criar demonstrações customizadas no ClickUp (e outras ferramentas) mostrando como a solução resolve o problema real do cliente.
  • Acompanhar períodos de teste (Trial): garantir que o lead tenha a melhor experiência durante os testes, tirando dúvidas e ajudando na configuração inicial.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente as negociações: ajudar a quebrar objeções técnicas e validar a viabilidade do que está sendo proposto.
  • Qualificar oportunidades: identificar se o cliente tem fit com nossas soluções e como podemos gerar mais valor.
  • Estudar e se atualizar constantemente sobre ClickUp, produtividade e metodologias de gestão.

O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento em ClickUp: não precisa ser avançado, mas você precisa conhecer a ferramenta, já ter usado em projetos reais e ter curiosidade pra se aprofundar.
  • Boa comunicação: saber se expressar com clareza em reuniões, ter escuta ativa e conseguir traduzir coisas complexas em linguagem simples.
  • Noções de gestão de projetos: entender conceitos básicos de métodos ágeis (Kanban, Scrum), fluxos de trabalho e organização de processos.
  • Perfil investigativo: gostar de fazer perguntas, entender problemas e pensar em soluções, mesmo quando o cliente não sabe explicar exatamente o que precisa.
  • Organização e autonomia: capacidade de gerenciar suas próprias demandas e acompanhar múltiplos leads simultaneamente.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Certificações do ClickUp (ClickUp Expert, Admin, etc.)
  • Experiência com Monday.com, Notion ou outras ferramentas de produtividade
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de integração (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • Experiência anterior com consultoria, implantação de sistemas ou suporte técnico
  • Noções de vendas B2B (funil de vendas, qualificação de leads, jornada do cliente)
  • Ter estruturado algum projeto ou workspace complexo no ClickUp

O que oferecemos

  • Crescimento acelerado: você vai aprender diretamente com especialistas e terá acesso a treinamentos internos constantes.
  • Exposição a diferentes negócios: cada cliente é um case novo, você vai conhecer dezenas de operações e mercados diferentes.
  • Trabalho 100% remoto: flexibilidade total de localização.
  • Ambiente colaborativo: time pequeno, próximo, sem burocracia, onde sua opinião importa desde o dia 1.
  • Evolução rápida: possibilidade real de crescer para Consultor Pleno e Sênior conforme seu desenvolvimento.

Obs: Se possível, inclua um breve relato (texto ou vídeo de até 2 min) sobre: Um projeto ou fluxo que você já montou/organizou no ClickUp OU por que você acredita que seria um bom fit para essa posição.

description:

title: Analista de Controle de Materiais
description:

Como Analista Pleno de Controle de Materiais você será responsável por realizar o controle e acompanhamento de materiais nacionais e importados, garantindo a disponibilidade dos itens conforme a demanda da operação.   • Superior em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas afins;

title: Técnico (a) de manutenção
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Structural Analysis Engineer - Mid Level
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level Structural Analysis Engineer to support aerospace and/or aeronautical engineering projects, with a focus on metallic and/or composite structures. The engineer will be responsible for performing static analysis, fatigue analysis, and damage tolerance evaluations to support product development, certification, modifications, and in-service support activities.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in structural calculations, interpretation of technical requirements, engineering drawings, finite element modeling, and technical report preparation. A solid understanding of strength of materials, structural mechanics, margins of safety, and structural substantiation methods is required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform static analysis of aircraft structures using hand calculations and/or finite element methods.
  • Support fatigue and structural life assessments under technical guidance.
  • Support damage tolerance evaluations, including crack growth assessment and inspection criteria.
  • Prepare finite element models, loads, boundary conditions, and basic correlation activities.
  • Prepare clear and traceable technical reports aligned with certification requirements.
  • Interface with design, loads, materials, certification, manufacturing, and product support teams.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • Approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in structural analysis.
  • Experience with tools such as Nastran, Patran, FEMAP, HyperMesh, Abaqus, ANSYS, or similar.
  • Experience with metallic and/or composite aircraft structures.
  • Knowledge of static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance, structural margins, and certification documentation.
  • Technical English for reading, report writing, and engineering communication.

title: Production Engineer - Wireless Industrialization and Tax Processes Specialist
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Production Engineer or Industrialization Specialist to support the development and implementation of local manufacturing and assembly strategies for ZTE's telecommunications products in Brazil.

The primary focus of this position will be to evaluate and enable the local production of Wireless RAN and Microwave (MW) equipment, including radio units, baseband units, antennas, transmission equipment, cabinets, power systems, accessories, and related components.

This professional will act as a key interface among Engineering, Product Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Logistics, Finance, local manufacturing partners, and ZTE's global teams.

The position requires a combination of industrial engineering, product-cost analysis, tax knowledge, and project coordination. The professional will be responsible for developing feasible local-production models, ensuring compliance with Brazilian industrial and tax regulations, and evaluating the effects of the Brazilian Tax Reform on manufacturing costs, tax credits, sourcing strategies, and product competitiveness.

Main Responsibilities

Local Production and Industrialization

  • Evaluate Wireless RAN and Microwave product families for potential local manufacturing, assembly, integration, configuration, testing, and repair in Brazil.
  • Develop industrialization strategies for radio units, baseband equipment, antennas, microwave radios, indoor and outdoor units, cabinets, power systems, and related telecom products.
  • Analyze different production models, including local manufacturing, outsourced manufacturing, contract manufacturing, CKD/SKD assembly, and partial localization of components.
  • Coordinate the implementation of local production projects from feasibility study through pilot production and mass production.
  • Define production workflows, assembly sequences, testing procedures, quality checkpoints, required tooling, labor demand, and factory capacity.
  • Prepare industrial process flowcharts, work instructions, technical reports, and project documentation.
  • Support prototype, pilot, first-article, and production-validation activities.
  • Monitor production performance, lead time, yield, quality indicators, manufacturing costs, and corrective-action plans.

Product Localization and Cost Analysis

  • Review product BOMs to identify opportunities for local sourcing, component substitution, process simplification, and cost reduction.
  • Develop localization roadmaps for selected Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Perform make-or-buy analyses and compare imported-product costs with local-production scenarios.
  • Prepare business cases covering investment requirements, production volume, manufacturing costs, tax impacts, logistics costs, and expected financial returns.
  • Identify Brazilian suppliers and manufacturing partners capable of meeting ZTE's technical, quality, cost, capacity, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate technical alignment between Brazilian suppliers, outsourced factories, and ZTE's global R&D and product teams.
  • Support negotiations with contract manufacturers and monitor their operational and contractual performance.

PPB, Regulatory Compliance and Incentives

  • Analyze and implement applicable Basic Productive Process (PPB) requirements for telecommunications and electronic products.
  • Evaluate industrial and regional incentive structures, including projects involving SUFRAMA and the Manaus Free Trade Zone, when applicable.
  • Monitor compliance with production stages, local-content requirements, investment commitments, documentation, and traceability obligations.
  • Support applications, technical projects, reports, and evidence required by government authorities and incentive programs.
  • Ensure alignment among BOM structure, manufacturing processes, import records, production orders, inventories, and tax documentation.
  • Support ANATEL-related product-compliance activities when they interact with industrialization, local configuration, or product modifications.
  • Assist internal and external audits and inspections conducted by SUFRAMA, Receita Federal, SEFAZ, and other regulatory authorities.

Tax Processes and Brazilian Tax Reform

  • Evaluate the tax impacts of local production versus importation for Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Support the correct classification of products, components, kits, and raw materials under the NCM.
  • Coordinate the preparation and validation of the FCI – Import Content Statement, when applicable.
  • Work closely with the Tax team to ensure the correct application and recovery of tax credits throughout the manufacturing and supply chain.
  • Analyze the effects of Brazil's Tax Reform on industrialization projects, particularly the transition from the current tax system to CBS and IBS.
  • Assess how the new tax-credit model may affect product costs, local sourcing, contract manufacturing, inventory flows, transfers, imports, sales, and customer pricing.
  • Monitor the coexistence of legacy taxes and the new consumption-tax system during the transition period.
  • Support adaptations to ERP, costing, purchasing, inventory, invoicing, and tax-control processes required by the Tax Reform.
  • Analyze the effects of ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, CBS, IBS and, when applicable, the Selective Tax and regional tax incentives on industrial projects.
  • Maintain documentation and calculation models that allow ZTE to compare tax burdens and credit utilization under different production and sourcing scenarios.
  • Work with Tax, Finance, IT, and ERP teams to ensure the traceability of tax credits from component acquisition through production and final sale.
  • Monitor regulatory changes that may affect PPB rules, Manaus Free Trade Zone incentives, local manufacturing, imported content, or telecom-equipment taxation.

Systems, Inventory and Process Integration

  • Support the configuration and continuous improvement of industrial, inventory, purchasing, costing, and tax processes in ERP systems.
  • Ensure consistency among engineering BOMs, production BOMs, purchase orders, import systems, warehouse balances, production orders, and accounting records.
  • Support integrations and reconciliations involving PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, import-management systems, and other internal platforms.
  • Identify process gaps that may generate incorrect inventory balances, tax-credit losses, production delays, or accounting inconsistencies.
  • Participate in automation, data-analysis, and artificial-intelligence initiatives aimed at improving industrial planning, tax controls, documentation, and operational productivity.

Project Management and Cross-functional Coordination

  • Lead cross-functional industrialization projects involving Engineering, Product, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Finance, Logistics, Quality, IT, and external manufacturing partners.
  • Develop project schedules, define responsibilities, monitor deliverables, and report risks and progress to management.
  • Coordinate technical and commercial discussions with ZTE headquarters and international product teams.
  • Translate global product and manufacturing requirements into processes compatible with Brazilian industrial, tax, and regulatory conditions.
  • Present recommendations, business cases, risks, and project results to local and global leadership.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering, production-process implementation, or local assembly of electronic or telecommunications products.
  • Experience with BOM analysis, production workflows, cost structures, and outsourced manufacturing.
  • Practical knowledge of Brazilian taxes and industrial regulations related to manufacturing, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, NCM, FCI, and PPB.
  • Knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its main operational impacts, especially CBS, IBS, tax-credit traceability, and the transition between tax systems.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including cost simulations, scenario analysis, reconciliations, and data processing.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering specifications, BOMs, production documents, tax legislation, and regulatory requirements.
  • Intermediate or advanced English for meetings, technical discussions, documentation, and interaction with ZTE's global teams.
  • Availability to visit suppliers, factories, warehouses, and production partners when required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with Wireless RAN, Microwave, telecommunications infrastructure, or radio-frequency equipment.
  • Knowledge of the architecture and main components of radio access and microwave-transmission systems.
  • Previous experience in the localization or nationalization of telecom or electronic products.
  • Experience with contract manufacturers, electronics manufacturing services, CKD/SKD operations, or outsourced assembly.
  • Experience with PPB projects, SUFRAMA, the Manaus Free Trade Zone, or other Brazilian industrial-incentive programs.
  • Knowledge of PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, MES, PLM, or other ERP and manufacturing systems.
  • Familiarity with product-costing methodologies, standard cost, landed cost, and manufacturing variance analysis.
  • Experience with ANATEL certification processes or other telecom regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, process mapping, quality tools, or project-management methodologies.
  • Experience using business-intelligence, automation, data-analysis, or artificial-intelligence tools.
  • Knowledge of Mandarin Chinese will be considered an advantage.

Requirement:

  • 7 years of experience in implementation in production, quality, supply chain, industrialization and tax;
  • Graduated in Engineering;
  • Fluent English.

title: Consultor(a) Sênior de Tributos Indiretos - Florianópolis
description:
Você na Deloitte

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Consultor(a) Sênior de Tributos Indiretos no time de Tax. Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Interpretar e aplicar a legislação tributária vigente, assegurando compliance, mitigação de riscos e aderência regulatória;
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos, memorandos e apresentações executivas, apoiando a tomada de decisão de clientes e stakeholders;
  • Atuar em projetos de consultoria tributária, incluindo revisões fiscais, planejamento tributário, implementação de melhorias operacionais, recuperação de créditos e temas relacionados à reforma tributária;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento próximo com clientes, atuando como parceiro estratégico do negócio e identificando oportunidades de agregação de valor;
  • Apoiar e orientar profissionais menos experientes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento da equipe e disseminação de conhecimento técnico;
  • Monitorar mudanças na legislação e tendências do mercado, avaliando impactos e propondo soluções estruturadas para os clientes.

Prezamos pelos In-Person Moments that Matter (momentos presenciais que importam) e, com isso, o modelo de trabalho adotado é o Digital Workplace, ou seja, em trabalho híbrido (remoto e presencial) com frequência de idas presenciais adaptadas de acordo com a necessidade da área. Na Consultoria Tributária, o time atua 3 (três) vezes por semana em formato presencial, sejam nas dependências físicas dos escritórios da Deloitte ou de nossos clientes.

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências.

Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

  • Formação superior em Direito, Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em tributos indiretos, preferencialmente adquirida em consultorias;

  • Conhecimento avançado da legislação tributária brasileira e práticas de compliance fiscal;
  • Inglês desejável para atuação em projetos e interações com clientes e stakeholders globais.

Esperamos você neste time!

title: Pesquisador Doutor - TOROID DO BRASIL - Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

TOROID DO BRASIL. Modernização industrial é um dos grandes motores da competitividade no setor elétrico, e você pode ser protagonista dessa transformação.

Estamos iniciando um programa estratégico focado na inovação em processos produtivos e no desenvolvimento de novos produtos na linha de transformadores toroidais e de média tensão — áreas essenciais para a expansão tecnológica da indústria. O projeto busca integrar melhorias produtivas, otimização de fluxo fabril e criação de soluções avançadas para novos mercados, fortalecendo a presença da empresa no cenário nacional e global.

Por isso, a atuação de um doutor especializado na área é fundamental: alguém capaz de liderar decisões técnicas complexas, orientar o desenvolvimento de protótipos, aplicar metodologias industriais de alto nível e guiar o estudo de expansão fabril com rigor científico e visão estratégica. Se você tem perfil inovador, gosta de resolver desafios reais da indústria e deseja atuar em um ambiente onde pesquisa, tecnologia e impacto caminham juntos, essa oportunidade é para você!

Projeto:

Implantação de Programa de Inovação em Processos e Desenvolvimento de Novos Produtos na Linha de Transformadores Toroidais e de média tensão.

title: Vendedor Autopeças - Joaquina Ramalho - SP
description:
Sobre a AutoZone

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 161 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.

A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além.   • Ensino médio completo;
  • Pacote Office - básico;
  • Experiência de 1 a 3 anos em atividades relacionadas à função
  • Conhecimento em mecânica automotiva (diferencial);

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.

Venha crescer com a AutoZone e impulsionar o futuro da sua carreira!

title: Cost Controller
description:
Our organization is hiring for an experienced Cost Controller in Rio. The Cost Controller is responsible for managing and monitoring project and operational costs to ensure alignment with budget and financial objectives. The role includes preparing and maintaining budgets and forecasts, conducting cost and variance analysis, tracking expenditures, identifying financial risks and cost-saving opportunities, and providing accurate financial reporting to support decision-making. The Cost Controller works closely with operational and finance teams to enhance cost visibility, ensure compliance with financial controls and company policies, and drive financial performance through effective cost management and resource utilization.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Develop, maintain, and monitor project and operational budgets
  • Prepare periodic forecasts and analyze budget versus actual performance
  • Track and control costs to ensure adherence to approved budgets
  • Perform detailed variance analysis and provide explanations for cost deviations
  • Prepare accurate and timely financial reports, dashboards, and management summaries
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and recommend corrective actions to improve financial performance
  • Monitor project commitments, accruals, and expenditures to ensure financial accuracy
  • Collaborate with operational, project, procurement, and finance teams to support cost management initiatives

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in cost control, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, or project accounting
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial reporting skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Dynamics)
  • Knowledge of budgeting, cost management, variance analysis, and financial controls
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Ability to identify financial risks and cost-saving opportunities
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities
  • Advanced English proficiency in multinational environments
  • Professional certifications (CMA, CPA, CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent) are a plus

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They're among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models
  • Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance
  • Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact
  • Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs
  • Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite
  • Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

  • Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm
  • Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages
  • A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience in the second line of defence (risk)
  • Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
SC — Regional Sales Representative

Quectel | LATAM | Sales & Business Development

Position Details

Job Title: SC — Regional Sales Representative

Department: Sales & Business Development — LATAM

Reports To: Regional Sales Manager / Director, LATAM

Location: Santa Catarina, Brazil

Work Arrangement: Hybrid — with regular field visits across the assigned territory

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Frequent travel across Santa Catarina and the LATAM region (customer visits, trade shows)

Role Overview

The SC — Regional Sales Representative will be a key growth driver for Quectel LATAM, responsible for maximizing Quectel's market share in the region on Non-Cellular product lines (e.g., GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite communication, antennas) and new market segments. This will be achieved through a dedicated focus on market analysis and by winning new verticals and customers centered on these product lines.

Acting as the face of Quectel in Santa Catarina, this professional will map and develop the full commercial potential of the territory — prospecting new customers, engaging underserved segments, and ensuring that every technology company in the region knows Quectel and its affiliate solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand the needs and expectations of customers and provide relevant, solution-oriented recommendations.
  • Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory.
  • Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards.
  • Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments.
  • Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel.
  • Train the Quectel Sales Force and Rep Firms/Distributors on the assigned product lines and follow up on resulting opportunities.
  • Create a Monthly Territory Discussion Report covering leads, technical evaluations, meeting plans, roadmap calls, and related activities.
  • Operate CRM (customer relationship management) systems and ensure authentic, up-to-date information is available within the company.
  • Visit exhibitor booths at trade shows to identify accounts and products that use cellular modules and obtain contact information.
  • Ensure 100% of technology customers in the region/state get to know Quectel and its affiliate solutions.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required

  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years in sales positions within the IoT segment.
  • Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Customer-Centric: Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.
  • Location: Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, LoRa, satellite communication, and antennas.
  • Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil.
  • Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial IoT, or connected mobility verticals.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and standard productivity software.
  • Spanish language skills a plus.

About Quectel

Quectel is a global IoT solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and IoT connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.

With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (IoT platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.

Life at Quectel LATAM

At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.

  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in IoT modules.
  • Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
  • Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams.
  • A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.

Industries & Applications

Quectel's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:

  • Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions.
  • Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility.
  • Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking.
  • Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring.
  • Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring.
  • Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility.
  • Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security.

Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications.
  • Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.
  • Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Performance bonus / sales commission structure.
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).

Explore Quectel — Links & Resources

We encourage all candidates to learn more about Quectel before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.

Company & Careers

Company Website: — Global IoT solutions provider

Technical & Developer Resources

Product Selector: quectel.com/product-selector — Browse the full portfolio of IoT modules and antennas

title: Advogado Associado
description:
Oportunidade: Advogado(a) Associado(a) – Núcleo de Agronegócio e Direito Bancário | Curitiba/PR

DFR Advogados Tradição Jurídica. Visão de Futuro.

Com sede no bairro Batel, em Curitiba/PR, e filial em Guarantã do Norte/MT, atuamos em todo o território nacional unindo tradição, inovação e compromisso com resultados que transformam. No cenário atual de forte expansão de nossas operações, estamos selecionando um(a) Advogado(a) Associado(a) de alta performance para integrar o nosso núcleo focado em Direito do Agronegócio e Direito Bancário.

Buscamos um profissional com sólida bagagem técnica processual, raciocínio estratégico apurado, excelente escrita e capacidade de gerenciar demandas sob regime de alta produtividade, mantendo a excelência no relacionamento direto com o cliente.

Escopo de Atuações e Responsabilidades:

O profissional será peça-chave na condução das estratégias jurídicas do núcleo, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Contencioso Estratégico: Elaboração e posicionamento técnico de petições de alta complexidade (iniciais, defesas, recursos aos Tribunais Estaduais e Tribunais Superiores, e peças de alta especificidade técnica);
  • Atuação Concorrente: Gestão de carteira de processos envolvendo contratos bancários, garantias reais, operações de crédito, títulos de crédito do agronegócio e renegociações de dívidas;
  • Atividade Prática de Tribunais: Realização de audiências (instrução e julgamento, conciliações e sustentações orais) e despachos estratégicos e personalizados diretamente com magistrados, assessores e chefias de secretaria;
  • Consultivo e Relacionamento: Atendimento direto, consultivo e resolutivo à carteira de clientes do núcleo (produtores rurais, empresários e players do setor), convertendo teses complexas em soluções claras e seguras.

Requisitos e Qualificações Obrigatórias:

  • Inscrição regular na OAB com, no mínimo, 2 anos de efetiva experiência prática na advocacia contenciosa;
  • Sólida e comprovada experiência de atuação em Direito Civil, Direito Processual Civil e Direito Bancário;
  • Domínio técnico na análise de contratos, estruturas de garantias e execuções de títulos;
  • Excelente habilidade de escrita jurídica (redação clara, coesa, com vocabulário técnico polido e robusto);
  • Raciocínio lógico-jurídico voltado à inteligência estratégica do processo;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia e inteligência emocional perante rotinas de alta demanda.

Diferenciais Valorizados:

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Direito Civil, Processo Civil, Direito Bancário ou Direito do Agronegócio;
  • Experiência prática prévia voltada especificamente às demandas jurídicas do Agronegócio (crédito rural, contratos agrários, etc.).

Condições e Informações da Vaga:

  • Regime de Contratação: Advocacia Associada (Modalidade de Associação);
  • Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Presencial;
  • Localidade: Bairro Batel – Curitiba/PR;
  • Jornada: Segunda a sexta-feira.

Processo de Candidatura:

Se você possui o perfil de excelência que buscamos e deseja atuar com demandas estratégicas de relevância nacional, faça parte do nosso time.

Os profissionais interessados deverão encaminhar uma breve carta de apresentação (destacando sua experiência na área civil/bancária) acompanhada do currículo atualizado para o e-mail:

Indicar no assunto do e-mail: "Vaga: Advogado Associado – Agro/Bancário"

description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

title: Head of Risk, Brazil
description:
Role Objective: We are seeking an experienced and highly strategic Statutory Risk Officer to

lead our Risk Management function in Brazil. This executive role is pivotal in acting as the

primary interface with local regulatory bodies, specifically the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Operational and Technology Risk, ensuring

our fast-paced operations remain resilient, secure, and fully compliant.

About the Role

As the Statutory Risk Officer, you will hold statutory responsibility for the company's risk

management framework in Brazil. You will act as the designated point of contact for BACEN and

other relevant regulatory bodies, advocating for the business while ensuring strict adherence to local regulatory expectations. While the role requires holistic oversight of the enterprise risk landscape, the primary mandate is to architect, implement, and govern a robust Operational Risk and Technology Risk framework. You will partner with business and technology leaders to identify vulnerabilities, mitigate technological threats, and foster a culture of proactive risk management.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Leadership & Statutory Duties

  • Act as the formally appointed Statutory Risk Director before the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN),fulfilling all duties required by BACEN Resolution and related regulations.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for all regulatory inquiries, audits, and supervisory exams related to risk management.
  • Ensure accurate and timely submission of all mandated risk reports to regulators.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and proactively adapt the risk framework to meet emerging legislative and supervisory requirements.

Operational cum Technology Risk Management

  • Oversee the end-to-end Operational Risk Management (ORM) framework, including Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Incident Management.
  • Establish and monitor operational risk appetite metrics and thresholds, escalating breaches to the management
  • Drive business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategies to ensure operational resilience.
  • Provide in-depth oversight of Technology Risk, Information Security, and Cyber Security
  • frameworks.
  • Evaluate risks associated with digital transformations, cloud migrations, API integrations, and new technology deployments.
  • Oversee Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), focusing heavily on critical IT vendors and outsourced technology service providers.
  • Review and challenge incident response protocols and post-mortem analysis for IT disruptions or cyber incidents.

Financial Risk (Advantageous Focus)

Good knowledge over end-to-end financial, fraud risk management during payment and money conversion and transfer process, for dual B2C (high-volume, rapid retail transactions) and B2B (high-value invoice/account-to-account payouts) flows.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • Strong experience in risk management and/or internal controls within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (banks, payment institutions, brokerages, or asset managers).
  • Solid working knowledge of BCB regulatory processes, norms, and resolutions.
  • Prior experience engaging directly with BCB and/or CVM in a regulatory/supervisory context.
  • Strong understanding of prudential risk frameworks (capital, RWA, operational risk).
  • Brazilian national or foreign national with valid Brazilian residency (statutory officer requirement).
  • Availability and willingness to be formally listed as a company officer with associated legal responsibilities.
  • Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English.
  • Prior experience in virtual assets, crypto, or fintech risk management.
  • Domain Expertise: SME-level knowledge in Operational Risk and Technology/Cyber Risk methodologies.
  • Professional certifications in risk management (e.g., FRM, CRM) a plus.
  • Familiarity with VASP-specific prudential frameworks and evolving BCB guidance on RWA treatment for digital asset activities.

P/S: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to overwhelming applicants.

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Você mantém uma forte orientação para resultados. Você persiste em alcançar objetivos, apesar de obstáculos e contratempos. Você mantém um histórico de superar metas com sucesso. Você se prontifica para lidar com questões difíceis. Você define objetivos alinhados com as metas mais amplas da organização. Você desdobra objetivos em iniciativas e ações apropriadas. Espanhol

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. description:

A major Japanese multinational in the technology and manufacturing sector is establishing its internal controls area and opening a brand-new opportunity for a Financial Controller with a strong analytical profile, systemic vision, and hands-on approach.

This role reports directly to the Finance Director, with regular interaction with external teams, acting as the technical reference for internal controls, financial compliance, and audit.

Your Mission:

Internal Process Control

  • Map, document, and review critical operational and financial processes
  • Identify gaps and recommend improvements to existing controls
  • Manage corporate approval workflows (Ringi system)

Financial Control & Compliance

  • Monitor revenue and expense cycles, AP/AR, treasury, and fixed assets
  • Ensure compliance with CPC/IFRS and local tax regulations (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS)
  • Analyze financial statements to identify anomalies or fraud risks

Audit & Risk Management

  • Serve as the focal point for internal (headquarters) and external audits
  • Maintain and update the company's risk matrix
  • Track action plans resulting from audits and regulatory inspections

Technology & Tools

  • Leverage ERP systems (SAP or Oracle) and BI tools (Power BI / Advanced Excel) for analysis and reporting
  • Prepare management reports to support decision-making

Requirements:

Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or Finance (active CRC is a plus)

Experience in internal control, internal/external audit, or financial management

Advanced English – required for reports and communication with headquarters

Knowledge of CPC/IFRS, Brazilian tax legislation, and COSO framework

Experience with SAP or Oracle and Power BI / Advanced Excel

Knowledge of LGPD (desirable, not mandatory)

What makes this role unique:

A empresa possui uma estrutura enxuta e próxima, na qual os profissionais participam diretamente dos projetos, tendo contato com clientes e espaço para contribuir tecnicamente com o desenvolvimento das soluções.

A oportunidade é para atuação em projetos de máquinas, dispositivos, linhas de produção, montagem e pré-montagem e movimentação de materiais.

Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Projetista Mecânico / Líder de Projetos para atuar no desenvolvimento dos projetos e também no acompanhamento e orientação da equipe envolvida nos trabalhos.

A posição combina atuação técnica em projetos mecânicos, contato com clientes e liderança da equipe, sendo indicada para um profissional que tenha experiência prática em desenvolvimento de máquinas e dispositivos e que tenha interesse em assumir uma posição de referência dentro da equipe.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Apoiar a elaboração de propostas comerciais e estudos de viabilidade;
  • Acompanhar as horas e os custos previstos dos projetos;
  • Orientar tecnicamente a equipe e contribuir para o desenvolvimento dos profissionais.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Produção, Tecnologia em Mecânica, Mecatrônica ou áreas relacionadas.

Procuramos um profissional com perfil prático, técnico e participativo, que goste de acompanhar de perto o desenvolvimento dos projetos e contribuir na busca de soluções.

É importante ter boa comunicação, organização, facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e capacidade de orientar tecnicamente outros profissionais.

Acreditamos que agilidade e simplicidade são a melhor forma de trabalhar e estamos sempre prontos para sugerir novas soluções para serviços e produtos, afinal, a inovação está no nosso DNA, o que nos leva a inspirar nossos colaboradores a atuarmos juntos, como um só time, com foco do cliente.

Para isso, oferecemos um ambiente propício ao desenvolvimento e benefícios atrativos de mercado. Esperamos você para seguirmos juntos cuidando da saúde!

É necessário que tenha:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Fonoaudiologia com registro no Conselho Regional de Classe;
  • Desejável conhecimento na área hospitalar com atendimento Adulto.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Responsável por avaliar, diagnosticar, orientar, reabilitar e/ou adequar as alterações das funções estomatognáticas, mecânicas ou neurológicas, inerentes as patologias assistidas, por meio do atendimento, visando orientar a equipe de apoio, assegurando conhecimento sobre os riscos à estabilidade clínica, promover ganhos possíveis dentro do quadro base e reduzir possibilidades de complicações advindas destas alterações, junto a equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Prestar atendimento fonoaudiológico ao paciente assegurando a melhor conduta terapêutica dentro do escopo do programa indicado;
  • Avaliar os sintomas fonoaudiológicos realizando diagnóstico e traçando planejamento e condutas terapêuticas para melhor prognóstico;
  • Orientar e capacitar familiares e cuidadores sobre as formas adequadas de consciência, posicionamento, consistência, volume, manobras de oferta dos alimentos;
  • Assegurar compreensão dos sinais e sintomas da disfagia, bem como os riscos à estabilidade clínica do paciente;
  • Atendimento a pacientes críticos em terapia intensiva.

Horário e Local de Trabalho:

  • 07:00 às 16:48 - Segunda a sexta-feira.
  • Av. Juiz Marco Túlio Isaac, 3400 - Betim Industrial, Betim - MG

A Unimed-BH respeita a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas vagas. Sem distinção de idade, gênero, orientação sexual, cor, raça, religião ou deficiência.

Identificou-se com os requisitos? Clique em "Candidatura Simplificada" e faça a sua inscrição! No portal de vagas da Unimed-BH, você encontra essa e outras oportunidades da Cooperativa. Acesse vagas.unimedbh.com.br e faça parte do nosso time.

title: Analista Supervisor de Compras e Almoxarifado
description:
Analista de Compras e Supervisor de Almoxarifado

Você tem perfil executor, é entende de organização, processos e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que transforma a realidade das pessoas através da moradia?

Responsabilidades

Nesta posição, você será o guardião dos nossos insumos, atuando desde a negociação estratégica até a garantia de que o canteiro de obras esteja perfeitamente abastecido e organizado.

  • Gestão de Compras: Realizar cotações, pedidos de compras e negociações estratégicas de contratos para garantir as melhores condições comerciais e otimização de custos.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores: Prospectar, realizar a qualificação contínua de fornecedores, analisar avaliações de recebimento de materiais e desqualificar parceiros quando necessário.
  • Supervisão de Almoxarifado: Garantir o rigoroso controle de estoque, avaliando materiais no recebimento e registrando tudo conforme a TIA (Tabela de Inspeção e Aceitação).
  • Controle e Organização: Assegurar a organização impecável dos materiais no almoxarifado e no canteiro de obras, além do controle rigoroso de notas fiscais, pedidos e recibos.
  • Qualidade e Compliance: Conferir as normas dos materiais no recebimento, garantindo a compra de insumos com certificados (conforme PCT) e assegurando o atendimento estrito aos requisitos da ISO 9001 e PBQP-H.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência: Vivência comprovada no gerenciamento de pedidos de compras (experiência na construção civil é um grande diferencial).
  • Hard Skills: Excel e ferramentas de controle de estoque. Conhecimento em normas de qualidade (ISO/PBQP-H).
  • Soft Skills: Habilidade analítica para tomada de decisão baseada em dados, capacidade de negociação e perfil altamente resolutivo.

With more than 1,800 business centers in over 40 countries, MBE is a trusted brand supporting SMEs and consumers worldwide. Our diversified service offering and globally tested systems make this a unique opportunity for business leaders looking to make a measurable impact in a dynamic and growing market.

  • Comprehensive training and operational support
  • Proven business model with global network
  • Scalable income potential through franchise network development

As the Master Franchisee, you will:

  • Launch and operate a corporate pilot center to establish the brand locally

Ready to Lead the Market in Brazil?

This is a strategic business ownership opportunity with long-term potential.

Contact us directly to discuss how you can bring Mail Boxes Etc. to Finland as a Master Franchisee.

Você será responsável por aproximar nossas tecnologias e soluções dos principais influenciadores e especificadores do mercado, contribuindo para que nossos produtos sejam considerados desde as fases iniciais dos projetos.

Tenha uma sólida base técnica, mas que também goste de estar próximo ao mercado e das pessoas. title: Analista Fiscal Sênior (Impostos Diretos e Indiretos)
description:
China Mobile International Brazil is seeking a Tax Executive to join our growing team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting the company's tax activities, ensuring accurate tax calculations, compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, timely submission of tax obligations, and proper management of tax-related documentation and processes.

The Tax professional will work closely with internal departments, external accounting firms, clients, vendors, and government authorities to ensure tax compliance, support business operations, and identify solutions to tax-related matters.

Work Location: Paulista Area, São Paulo

Work Model: 100% On-site

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform tax calculations and verify assessed taxes, including ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL, IRPJ, CSLL, FUST, FUNTTEL, and withholding taxes, requesting corrections whenever necessary.
  • Prepare and submit ancillary tax obligations, such as GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, DIRF, among others.
  • Collaborate with external accounting firms throughout the tax assessment process by providing accurate and timely information and documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits by gathering, reviewing, and providing all required documentation and information.
  • Keep tax clearance certificates up to date to support participation in public tenders and ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements.
  • Issue, review, and submit to clients invoices related to services, goods, rentals, imports, exports, and telecommunications.
  • Record and approve incoming invoices, verifying tax information and fiscal classifications, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Prepare tax payment slips, such as DARF, DARE, DARJ, and GNRE, among others, in coordination with the central payments team.
  • Validate tax and fiscal information related to REIDI.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings and directly perform the tax closing process, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the information.
  • Maintain relationships with government authorities, including the Receita Federal, SEFAZ, City Halls, and other relevant government agencies.
  • Provide tax support to other departments by addressing and clarifying tax-related questions from employees, vendors, and clients.
  • Participate in internal projects by providing tax guidance and proposing solutions to ensure tax compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare and submit IBGE reports on an annual basis, DICI reports on a monthly basis, and CODEF reports on a semi-annual basis.
  • Coordinate the tax and fiscal procedures related to the nationalization of imported services and products, ensuring compliance with applicable Brazilian tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company.
  • Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes.
  • Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF.
  • Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices.
  • Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company's operations.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Note:

  • Position offered shall be determined by the candidate's years of relevant experience and skillsets.
  • All personal data collected will be used for recruitment and employment-related purpose only.

title: Stablecoin BD Lead, LATAM
description:
About OSL Group

OSL Group (HK 00863) is Asia's leading digital asset platform and fintech pioneer. As the first SFC-licensed virtual asset platform in Hong Kong, OSL bridges traditional finance with the world of digital assets, providing institutional-grade custody, Over-The-Counter (OTC) trading, exchange execution, asset tokenization, and stablecoin payment infrastructure (OSL Pay / StableX).

We are expanding our regional operational hubs and building high-performing teams passionate about shaping compliant, global financial infrastructure.

About the Role

We are seeking an ambitious, institutional-focused Stablecoin Business Development Lead for Latin America to drive the adoption and distribution of USDGO—the enterprise-grade, federally regulated digital dollar issued by Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. and distributed by OSL Group.

With LATAM rapidly shifting toward digital dollar settlement for cross-border trade, B2B supplier payments, and corporate treasury management, your mission will be to position USDGO as the premier compliant stablecoin rail across Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina. You will originate, negotiate, and close strategic partnerships with local payment service providers (PSPs), cross-border trade facilitators, neobanks, local exchanges, and corporate financial networks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Regional GTM & USDGO Positioning: Formulate and execute a B2B-centric business development strategy across Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina, emphasizing USDGO's core differentiators: OCC regulation, GENIUS Act alignment, enterprise compliance, and 1:1 USD backing.
  • Fintech & Payment Rails Integration: Secure distribution channels by partnering with regional PSPs, payment gateways, and local clearing rails (e.g., Pix integration partners in Brazil, SPEI partners in Mexico) to power underlying B2B payment flows with USDGO.
  • Cross-Border B2B & Trade Settlement: Target supply chain networks, import/export corporates, and cross-border payment platforms to replace slow legacy SWIFT corridors with instant, 24/7 USDGO settlement.
  • Exchange & Liquidity Venue Partnerships: Drive USDGO listings, liquidity depth, and on/off-ramp integration across top regional exchanges and OTC desks (e.g., Bitso, Mercado Pago, Lemon, Ripio).
  • Corporate Treasury Adoption: Educate and pitch corporate CFOs, Web3 treasuries, and institutional platforms on leveraging USDGO for balance sheet management, corporate payouts, and inter-subsidiary transfers.
  • Deal Lifecycle & Integration: Oversee the end-to-end partnership process from origination to technical integration, working closely with regulatory, compliance, and product engineering teams.

Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years of proven Business Development, Institutional Sales, or Strategic Partnerships experience in Web3 (specifically Stablecoins/B2B Settlement) or Institutional Fintech/Payments (PSPs, Cross-Border Treasury, FX).
  • USDGO & Regulatory Literacy: Strong understanding of institutional-grade stablecoin mechanics, reserve attestations, and compliance-first positioning relative to un-regulated alternatives.
  • Regional Expertise: In-depth understanding of the commercial and regulatory financial landscapes in key markets:
  • Brazil: Pix ecosystem, local central bank VASP regulations, and B2B FX settlement flows.
  • Argentina: Parallel market dynamics, corporate demand for USD-denominated liquidity/hedging, and regional exchange networks.
  • Mexico: SPEI rails, US-MX B2B trade corridors, and FinTech Law frameworks.
  • Network: An active network of decision-makers across LATAM PSPs, neobanks, import/export corporations, Web3 platforms, and regional crypto exchanges.
  • Languages: Native or fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese, with full professional fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience at a stablecoin issuer, global institutional exchange, or cross-border payment provider operating in LATAM.
  • Familiarity with Solana and multi-chain stablecoin infrastructure, API-based payment integrations, and enterprise wallet management.

title: Estagiário
description:
O escritório Advocacia Trans busca estudantes de Direito integrados ou apoiadores da causa LGBTQIA+ para atuar na Savassi (Belo Horizonte/MG) em regime presencial. Diferente da prática jurídica comum e trivial, nosso cotidiano é pautado pelo desafio intelectual e pela criação de teses jurídicas complexas, exigindo forte pensamento crítico e capacidade de traduzir conceitos disruptivos para os julgadores.

Nossa atuação é profundamente multidisciplinar e transversal, integrando ramos como Direito Constitucional, Internacional, Trabalhista, Saúde, Criminal e do Consumidor de forma conjunta e estratégica para garantir providências reais, proteção e dignidade à nossa comunidade.

Atividades Desenvolvidas:

  • Pesquisa aprofundada de doutrinas, tratados internacionais e jurisprudências complexas.
  • Construção e desenvolvimento de teses jurídicas disruptivas com foco em Direitos Humanos.
  • Elaboração de peças processuais e administrativas utilizando perspectivas de gênero e as resoluções do CNJ.
  • Acompanhamento estratégico de processos e atendimento humanizado.

Qualificações e Requisitos:

  • Formação: Cursando graduação em Direito (preferencialmente a partir do 4o ou 5o período).
  • Perfil Intelectual: Excelente redação jurídica, raciocínio lógico-jurídico apurado, afinidade com filosofia do direito e capacidade de lidar com demandas multidisciplinares ao mesmo tempo.
  • Diferencial: Vagas voltadas prioritariamente a pessoas trans, travestis e integrantes da diversidade, além de estudantes apoiadores ativos da causa e da agenda de Direitos Humanos.

Detalhes da Oportunidade:

  • Carga horária: 4/6 horas diárias .
  • Modalidade: Presencial (Bairro Savassi, Belo Horizonte - MG).
  • Remuneração: Bolsa-auxílio de R$ 1.000,00.
  • Para conhecer mais sobre nosso trabalho, acesse no Instagram: @advocaciatrans.

title: Técnico de Automação PL
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Analisar, padronizar e customizar os programas dos CLPs (Controlador Lógico Programável), manter backups atualizados destes e dos supervisórios, para manutenção da segurança de operação das máquinas e manutenção do sistema;
  • Analisar, padronizar e customizar interfaces de operação, supervisórios e/ou IHMs (interface homem máquina), a fim de facilitar a operação e melhorar a qualidade das informações dos processos;
  • Fazer manutenção, calibrar e controlar os instrumentos das instalações, visando melhoria na qualidade do produto, redução no custo de produção e confiabilidade do processo produtivo;
  • Executar serviços de manutenção eletromecânica, eletroeletrônica, eletropneumática, eletrotécnica e instrumentação industrial, para o funcionamento dos equipamentos e reparar ou substituir partes e peças dos equipamentos elétricos;
  • Monitorar as atividades de manutenção preventivas, preditivas e ou corretivas programadas, acompanhando a mão de obra contratada durante a execução das atividades, bem como, disponibilizando os recursos necessários para a realização da atividade;
  • Especificar e inspecionar equipamentos para automação das máquinas, e implementar melhorias para maior confiabilidade do processo produtivo e aumento da produtividade;
  • Monitorar a tecnologia de automação disponível do mercado para adaptação ao processo produtivo e implementar pequenos projetos de automação.

Requisitos:

  • Curso Técnico completo em automação, eletromecânica e/ou eletrônica;
  • NR 10 básico e NR 10 SEP;
  • Conhecimento em manutenção de máquinas e equipamentos industriais;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Disponibilidade de horário para trabalhar em turnos;
  • Residir em Jaguariaíva ou Arapoti.

title: Supervisor de Loja - Canoas RS
description:
Sobre a vaga

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, contamos com mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas globalmente pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, apoiadas por mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 150 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo localizado em São Paulo, na região da Vila Leopoldina.

Em 2025, inauguramos nosso Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo nossa estrutura logística e sustentando nossa estratégia de expansão no país.

Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar o Gerente de loja no gerenciamento da loja;
  • Ajudar no desenvolvimento de novos AutoZoners;
  • Oferecer um atendimento especializado aos clientes;
  • Controle de estoque adequado, promovendo as vendas e mantendo aparência da loja;
  • Assegurar processo e documentação associada a venda, preços e conduzir inventários físicos;
  • Auxiliar os colaboradores com menos conhecimentos técnicos a efetuarem vendas corretas;

Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Vivência em liderança e atingimento de metas;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semanas e feriados;
  • Desejável conhecimento no pacote Office (nível básico);
  • Desejável conhecimento no segmento automotivo.

Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Escala de trabalho: 5x2 (folgas alternadas)
  • Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.
